# Border Width

::: info 实现进度 55% · 进行中
Playground 已 `@source` 文档 markdown，这些类名可在本页示例里跑。未写入 `helpers.css`；SDK 里 schema 动态 class 仍依赖源码扫描。`m:` / `pc:` 只接到间距和宽高。
:::

先写 `border` 才看得到线，再叠加色和样式。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: border border-border p-sm rounded-md
    tpl: border
  - type: tpl
    className: border-2 border-primary p-sm rounded-md m-t-sm
    tpl: border-2
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `border` | `1px 四边` |
| `border-0` | `0` |
| `border-2` | `2px` |
| `border-4` | `4px` |
| `border-t` | `上边` |
| `border-b` | `下边` |
| `border-l` | `左边` |
| `border-r` | `右边` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 目前只接到间距和宽高辅助类。其它类请用 Tailwind 断点（`max-md:` / `md:`）。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
